span.p:
Ask them to sign in
or create an account first

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Step 1: who they are
and their school or college

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Step 2: routes,
year group and consent

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Valid, and have they agreed
to be contacted?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Show what needs fixing,
or explain we need their permission

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Step 3: show their answers
so they can check them

span.p:
Replace their earlier answers
instead of adding a duplicate

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Thank them: interest registered
or details updated

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Routes: Digital, Business, Media,
Finance or Engineering. They can
remove their interest from their account.
